name: Sync PlusVibe Not Interested to DNC

workflows.CXuj6jR6pmMvAEas: Sync PlusVibe Not Interested to DNC

called_by: the Campaigns Manager, after the three campaign syncs, every run
description: For every client with a PlusVibe workspace and a ClayRoots base: reads the leads labelled Not interested or Unsubscribed on PlusVibe since the last manager run, takes their company domains (free-mail skipped), adds each to the PlusVibe workspace blocklist and creates a DNC row in the client's base with Reason Not interested and the campaign and email in Notes. A no from one person means the company is never contacted again, by any campaign, on any list. Hands one summary back to the manager; no row of its own.
